SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT E.*, S.USERNAME AS APPROVEUSERNAME, M.USERNAME AS REQUSERNAME, C.USERNAME AS RECYCLEUSERNAME FROM T_EMC_FILE_VERSION_DIST E LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER S ON E.APPROVERUSERID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER M ON E.REQUSERID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER C ON E.RECYCLEUSERID = C.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, S.USERNAME AS APPROVEUSERNAME, M.USERNAME AS REQUSERNAME, C.USERNAME AS RECYCLEUSERNAME FROM T_EMC_FILE_VERSION_DIST T LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER S ON T.APPROVERUSERID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER M ON T.REQUSERID = M.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER C ON T.RECYCLEUSERID = C.ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}
